short.text: Brad Meester started Jacksonville's first two games of 2013 at center and, after an injury in the second, dressed as the reserve center; he was active for {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. His protection calls and line communication were his defining value: he steadied the common calls and finished changed-front and twist work without help from the coaches. His movement blocking, second-level work and sustained physical blocking were below that mental operation.

transactions.text: Re-signed with Jacksonville for one year
Retirement applied after the 2013 season (announced December 18, 2013); contract ran to March 11, 2014
